infoLinks.urlText:
Moore Park Light Rail Lift between Anzac Pde and the footbridge is not available

L2/L3 Moore Park lifts out of service
infoLinks.content:
At Moore Park Light Rail Lift between Anzac Pde and the footbridge is temporarily out of service.
Both lifts at Moore Park light rail stop (both sides of the Dr Agnes Bennett footbridge) on the L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line are temporarily out of service until further notice.

For your safety, do not use even if the doors open.

Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs if able to,
  • Or use the accessible entry/exit pathway via the crossing at the intersection of Anzac Parade and Lang Road.
     
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform
  • Or call 131 500
